2608.28182.title: Benchmarking large language model agent societies against human behavioural distributions
2608.28182.paper_summary: Populations of large language model agents are increasingly used as experimental societies. Three doubts shadow every such result: whether the agents behave like the humans they stand in for, whether a finding survives changes to the apparatus that leave the rules untouched, and whether apparent social dynamics are interaction at all rather than the reproduction of experiments the models have read. This article introduces SILICA, an open instrument that tests all three. Five environments carry published human anchors, each paired with perturbations that re-render the same rules and with variants whose payoffs point away from the memorised result. Twelve open-weight models were run through it on a single consumer graphics card. Agreement with human data is confined to starting points: first-round public-goods contributions fall inside the equivalence margin for eight of eleven models, while no model matches end-state contributions or the human corridor of cooperation. Merely swapping the order in which two actions are listed costs one model 58 points of cooperation. Presenting responders with a fixed schedule of offers shows that only one model, the sole reasoning-trained one, places its acceptance threshold where the incentive requires; two move theirs part of the way, two move them the wrong way, and three never acquire one. Conventions form through a shared prior over the names rather than through negotiation, though negotiation reappears once that prior is disrupted. On the certification ladder defined here, current silicon societies support exploratory claims and no more.
2608.28182.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理的群體越來越多地被用作實驗社會。每個這樣的結果都籠罩著三個疑問：這些代理是否像他們所代表的人類那樣行為，這一發現是否能在不改變規則的情況下，經受住設備的變化，以及表面上的社會動態是否真的是互動，而不是模型所讀取的實驗的再現。本文介紹了SILICA，一個測試這三個問題的開放工具。五個環境承載著已發表的人類基準，每個環境都配有重新呈現相同規則的擾動，以及其收益指向與記憶結果不同的變體。十二個開放權重模型在一個消費級顯示卡上運行。與人類數據的一致性僅限於起始點：第一輪公共財貢獻在十一個模型中有八個落在等價邊際內，而沒有模型匹配最終狀態的貢獻或人類的合作走廊。僅僅改變兩個行動的列出順序就使一個模型失去了58個合作點。向反應者提供固定的報價時間表顯示，只有一個模型，即唯一接受推理訓練的模型，將其接受閾值設置在激勵所要求的位置；兩個模型將其部分調整，兩個模型則朝錯誤的方向移動，三個模型則從未獲得一個。慣例是通過對名稱的共同先驗形成，而不是通過談判，儘管一旦該先驗受到擾動，談判會重新出現。在這裡定義的認證梯度上，目前的矽社會支持探索性主張，僅此而已。
2608.28182.author: Raad Bin Tareaf et.al.
